spans.s: AT0231 नीला दीनां तमसश्च् दर्शनं nīlā dīnāṁ tamasaśc darśanaṁ Blue/dark vision It is a symptom produced in fifth impulse of poisoning which means that one’s vision becomes blue or in dark color.
AF1353 नीलाभं मूत्रं nīlābhaṁ mūtraṁ Bluish urine.
AF1354 नीलारुणाभं पुरीक्षां nīlāruṇābhaṁ purīkṣāṁ Reddish blue colored stool
AT0232 नीलोष्ठ nīloṣṭha Bluishness of lips due to cyanosis (asphyxia) which is sign of (imminent) death of poisoned patient.
